facts.text: Pull over and have some coffee. The Spurbury cops are not invited.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. The real coffee moment is Farva carrying the cups round the station: 'Coffee served! No, no, that one's for Rabbit!'.
facts.fix: Coffee served! No, no, that one's for Rabbit!

facts.text: Chief O'Hagan, shouting from the doorway
facts.why: John O'Hagan is the troopers' captain. The chief in the film is Bruce Grady of the Spurbury police.
